scenarios.name: Open the file menu while a part is active

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part document is active in the MCAD Software
a menu opens with New, Open, Save, Save As, Export, Print and Close entries
the menu also shows Share, Manage and document properties entries
the command entries form a vertical list on the left
a recent-documents region is visible to the right of that list
application options and an exit control appear at the bottom of the menu
the model workspace remains visible behind the menu
